title: Under Armour Tech 2.0 T-Shirt - SS21
description: Washing and Care Instructions for Clothes Washing instructions are provided on the label of each item. Generally, the instructions are as follows: • Machine wash cold with similar color. • Line dry or tumble dry on low heat. • Do not use bleach, fabric softeners or drying sheets as they can destroy the moisture wicking properties of the garment and cause them to deteriorate prematurely. Do not iron. Consider washing in a garment bag to protect your gear from snags caused by velcro, eye hooks or other sharp objects on other garments. Using an iron is not recommended, however, if you do, use only the polyester/synthetic temperature setting. Under Armour Men's Tech 2.0 T-Shirt - Ultra-light loose fit running shirt Ultra-light, breathable, quick-drying - the Under Armour running shirt impresses with its high-quality material and loose fit. The loose shape ensures absolute comfort. The short-sleeved T-shirt is made of particularly durable quality material. In addition, the material is ultra-light, breathable, and dries very quickly. The anti-odour technology prevents the growth of microbes and thus prevents the development of odours. The sports top allows sweat to escape and keeps you cool. The T-shirt also features an aerodynamic cut and curved hems. It is made of 100% polyester. UNDER ARMOUR MAKES ATHLETES BETTER Our story begins with a T-shirt, designed to provide an undeniable advantage to athletes. Today, thanks to us, athletes are rethinking the way they dress. Innovation is at the heart of our business and our vision: inspiring by offering solutions to improve your performance. Solutions that we could only dream of until now.
